description: ArcGIS Indoors is Esri's indoor mapping and space management software for building an indoor GIS of an organisation's facilities. It provides data management tools and focused apps for operations, maintenance, safety, security and wayfinding, showing people, spaces, assets and incidents on floor-aware 2D and 3D maps. CAD, BIM, lidar and other facility data can be brought into one map to see how spaces are used, manage and reserve space, locate and monitor assets, and improve situational awareness in emergencies. Coverage: any facility an organisation maps. Access: licensed through Esri sales as part of ArcGIS. Licence: commercial; paid. Caveats: proprietary, and indoor models must be built for each facility from the owner's drawings and scans. Simulation uses are floor-level digital twins of hospitals, campuses and government buildings for emergency response and indoor evacuation analysis. Related records: IFC and the evacuation models Pathfinder and EXODUS.
